-- name: ListAccountActivity
-- param: @account_id int
SELECT
    'order' AS kind,
    o.id AS ref_id,
    o.placed_at AS at,
    o.note AS detail
FROM orders o
WHERE o.account_id = @account_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'event',
    e.id,
    e.at,
    e.payload ->> 'ip'
FROM events e
WHERE e.account_id = @account_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'invoice',
    i.id,
    i.issued_on::timestamptz,
    i.paid_on::text
FROM billing.invoices i
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE o.account_id = @account_id
ORDER BY at DESC
LIMIT 50;
